description: This file defines classes for indexing link fields in OrchardCore content management system, including LinkFieldIndex and LinkFieldIndexProvider, which handle indexing logic for link fields within content items.

classes.name: LinkFieldIndex
classes.description: Represents the index data for a link field, including URL and text with size constraints.

classes.name: LinkFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for link fields within content items, mapping content fields to index entries.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to LinkFieldIndex entries, filtering out deleted or irrelevant items.
